paragraph: A preview in the public feed. The TV Dudes’ public Patreon RSS feed lists [PREVIEW] MUZZLE (2023) with an audio attachment and a listed duration of about five minutes. If an episode is labeled [PREVIEW], check the same episode on the creator’s page. If you have access to the full episode and the creator offers private audio RSS, get your personal feed link from Patreon. A short duration or a bonus label alone can’t identify a preview.
